correctness.rationale: Euclidean distance is a coupled minimum on the bidisk; angular orthogonality and a beta integral produce exact monomial norms. The differential recursion yields the m=1 zero-free numerator and the all-m diagonal-specialization polynomial recurrence. The coefficient degree/positivity induction and sign-interlacing argument prove strictly negative simple roots and a monotone interior root for all m>=2. The explicitly chosen bidisk point pairs realize the cross-products. Exact finite arithmetic checker supports but does not replace the universal proof.
